description: This walk takes you from the lovely beach at Mwnt to the neighbouring settlements of Gwbert and Cardigan. The walk runs for around 7 miles mainly following the stunning Ceredigion coast but with a section through the countryside around Gwbert. Along the way you can enjoy wonderful sea views, look out for a variety of sea birds and see some wonderful cliff top rock formations.
